path_conditions: pci_epf_test_write() is invoked from pci_epf_test_cmd_handler(), which is scheduled via INIT_DELAYED_WORK() in pci_epf_test_probe() — i.e. a workqueue handler that runs in process context and is therefore sleepable. The function itself also calls kzalloc(..., GFP_KERNEL), which is a sleeping allocation and so the function is provably non-atomic. Burning CPU via mdelay(1) (a busy-wait primitive) is wasteful; usleep_range(1000, 2000) should be used instead. This is the canonical 'delay-gfp' pattern (DSAC family — Jia-Ju Bai).
